title: INT of a fixed decimal (currency) value returns a fixed decimal

source.quote: If <Number> is a Currency , then the result is also a Currency data type.
source.supports: the result type follows a currency argument

source.quote: INT rounds <Number> towards −∞ to the nearest integer.

derivation: CURRENCY ( 2.9 ) is the fixed decimal 2.9. INT rounds it down to 2 and, for a currency argument, keeps the currency type: the decimal 2.
